review.feedback: English draft resting on a snapshot of the quality-trend citation columns, the two producing scripts and the 18 evolution records at Demerzel commit 4b03838800dcd4894f1e026461979bff1d985ca8 (20 count changes: 16 at the one change of citation_source, 4 between rows of the same source), and on a deterministic analysis whose 64 self-checks pass. The alarm rule it applies is an analysis choice and the rows of its first exercise are imaginary. Its reading of the four remaining steps relies on Git history read outside the fixture, and the git-grep count was not recomputed for the runs before the change. Human subject review, learner trial and publication remain pending; the French and Spanish translations have had no native-speaker review.
